releases.title: Reviewed shipped-changes ledger
capabilities: The private workbench exposes an accessible, keyboard-operable changelog that also works as a bounded mobile reading surface.
The interface shows the running artifact commit separately from each reviewed milestone commit.
Release rows bind pull-request and commit evidence, while CI independently verifies the recorded GitHub merge.
limitations: The ledger records reviewed shipped milestones; it is not a substitute for the complete engineering devlog or roadmap.
The running build identity is supplied independently by deployment and must be checked against the live API before release closure.
The service remains private and Tailnet-only, with ephemeral per-session memory.

deployment.label: Live · private Tailnet
deployment.detail: Reviewed PR #113 adds the shipped-changes reader; the deployed runtime build is reported separately.

releases.title: Private semantic workbench
capabilities: Allowlisted Tailnet users can talk with one isolated deterministic Clanker-LM runtime per browser session.
Every answer keeps six evidence fields visible: Answer, Truth, Source, Certainty, Memory, and VADUG.
The browser can export an inspectable snapshot or reset its ephemeral session memory.
limitations: This is a bounded research-alpha workbench, not a claim of unrestricted conversation.
Session memory is ephemeral; a service restart clears state that was not exported.
The service is private and Tailnet-only. It has no Funnel or public route.

deployment.label: Superseded · private Tailnet
deployment.detail: PR #106 established the private workbench baseline later extended by reviewed web releases.
